extension.summary: tofa media server: user interface, plus a browsable video source
extension.description:
An unofficial client for the tofa media server (tofa.tv), in two parts.
Under Programs, tofa opens a full user interface: Home, Browse, Discover, Search, title detail with cast and episodes, its own player chrome, and Settings.
Under Video add-ons, the same library appears as a browsable source, so it can also be used in widgets, favourites and Kodi's own containers.
Both play through Kodi's native VideoPlayer, negotiating DirectPlay/DirectFile so Dolby Vision, TrueHD/DTS-HD passthrough and refresh-rate matching reach it untouched.
extension.disclaimer: An unofficial tofa client, engineered with the tofa team, who also help support it.
extension.news: - Settings > Appearance > "Featured spotlight" now does something on this device. It had no effect here, even though switching it off still changed what your other tofa apps showed. Turning it off hides the large banner at the top of Home -- its title, logo and description -- and gives the space to your rows, so another row fits on screen. The artwork behind it stays, and still follows whichever card you are on. - Whichever option you are on in Settings now has an outline around it, so you can see where you are before you press anything. This covers the choices under Playback & Video, the rating badge under Appearance, and the switches beside your Home screen rows. - Browse > Collections puts each collection's name on a single line now, with the number of titles directly beneath it. Space was kept for a second line whether or not a name needed one, which left a gap under every name that fitted on one. A name too long to fit scrolls while you are on it. The rows also sit closer together, so more collections fit on screen.
